properties.description:
ARRIVED 2026-09-12. The second half of increment 431, which completes it: the server now writes the design export through to the working tree after every change, debounced, so a forgotten export stops being a class of loss.

TWO CHOICES ANTHONY MADE, 2026-09-12, each put to him with its consequence:
· HOW THE SERVER LEARNS THE PATH — an explicit `--export-to <FILE>`, rather than deriving it from export history. Deriving would have given every existing project the guarantee for free and would also mean one export to a scratch path silently re-targets the server's writes. `reflow2_init.py` now emits the flag for all three harnesses, pointed at the same docs/design/<project>.json that design_record_path names, so a consumer opts in without having to know the flag exists.
· A HAND-EDITED EXPORT — skip the write and warn loudly, rather than overwrite or wedge the session. Never destroys a hand edit or a half-resolved merge. The cost he accepted is that the export stops being current until somebody reads the warning, which is why the warning is in loop_status' `next` — the list a session acts on — and not a log line.

THE DEBOUNCE: two seconds of quiet, with a ten-second ceiling so a steady stream of writes cannot starve the export forever. A burst of thirty writes costs one export. Affordable because a full export of the largest design in existence is 265 ms.

THE HAND-EDIT BASELINE IS TRACKED TWICE, and that is not redundancy: the recorded sync needs a graph_path, which a memory-backed server does not have, so without an in-process baseline such a server's guard would never fire. The recorded one survives a restart and also moves when a SESSION exports deliberately, so a manual export never looks like tampering.

THE FILE-WRITE SEAM MOVED INTO ONE MODULE shared by the tool and the write-through. Two callers that must agree on where the lineage anchors, whether a write would drop work, and what `wrote` reports — a second copy that drifts is the failure this project keeps meeting.

A READ-ONLY SERVER IS REFUSED THE WRITE-THROUGH rather than silently given one: the mode exists so a surface with no authentication cannot change anything.

⚠️ A TEST CAUGHT LYING AND FIXED, worth keeping because it is the same lesson as NEW-01: the first debounce test passed with the debounce set to ZERO. Ten writes issued back to back coalesce whatever the quiet period is, because the task has not been scheduled yet — it was measuring the scheduler. Spacing the writes 300 ms apart makes it discriminate: 10 exports without the debounce, 1 with. Both directions verified before it was trusted.
properties.name: The server keeps the working-tree export current, and declines rather than overwrite a hand edit
